name: Stellula Eques Codex ~Tasogare no Himekishi~
original_name: ステルラ エクエス コーデックス～黄昏の姫騎士～
source:
Akira is an average guy. But one day, Izayoi, his classmate, suddenly seduces him and they have sex... After having sex, big white wings come out of Izayoi's back and she transforms herself into a soldier called Stellula Eques. An evil group also appears and Akira is attacked by them. Izayoi and other soldiers know about their conspiracy and try to stop it. 

What exactly is Akira's power?! What is Stellula Eques' role?! What will happen to them in the end!?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
阿基拉是一个普通人。但有一天，他的同学十六夜突然引诱他，他们发生了性关系……性交后，十六夜的背上长出了白色的大翅膀，她变成了一名名叫斯特鲁拉·艾克斯的士兵。邪恶组织也出现，阿基拉受到他们的攻击。十六夜和其他士兵知道了他们的阴谋并试图阻止它。

阿基拉到底有什么力量？！Stellula Eques的角色是什么？！他们最后会发生什么呢！？

[来自工口游戏商店]
